words.enDefinition: money received from consolidated

examples.en: Our consolidated income rose eleven percent this quarter, even though the German subsidiary struggled.
examples.zh: 尽管德国子公司表现不佳，我们的「合并收益」本季度仍增长了百分之十一。

examples.en: The CFO walked me through how intercompany dividends disappear when we report consolidated income.
examples.zh: 首席财务官向我讲解了编制「合并收益」时内部股利是如何相互抵销的。

words.enDefinition: earnings from consolidated retained

examples.en: Accumulated losses from the Brazil unit dragged consolidated retained earnings into negative territory last year.
examples.zh: 巴西子公司累积的亏损使「合并未分配利润」去年转为负数。

examples.en: Before approving our dividend, the board reviewed the movement in consolidated retained earnings.
examples.zh: 在批准分红之前，董事会审查了「合并未分配利润」的变动情况。

words.enDefinition: supply that is not immediately visible in reported stocks

examples.en: Traders say invisible supply, like unreported private stocks, is keeping copper prices from spiking.
examples.zh: 交易员说，未申报私人库存这类「市场外供应」抑制了铜价飙升。

examples.en: The USDA report ignores invisible supply held on farms, so the grain estimates look too tight.
examples.zh: 美国农业部的报告没有统计农场持有的「市场外供应」，因此谷物估产显得偏紧。

words.enDefinition: a position that profits if the asset’s price rises
acceptedZhAnswers: 对市场价格持看涨观点

examples.en: He built a long position in the stock early last spring, well before the takeover rumor.
examples.zh: 早在去年春天收购传闻出现之前，他就建立了这只股票的「多头头寸」。

examples.en: The fund trimmed its long position in wheat futures once the weather forecast turned favorable.
examples.zh: 天气预报转为有利后，该基金减持了小麦期货的「多头头寸」。

words.enDefinition: brokerage that has been received

examples.en: Her agency lives on brokerage received from the shipping lines for each booking she places.
examples.zh: 她的代理行主要靠每笔订舱业务从船公司「领取手续费」维持经营。

examples.en: Brokers must disclose all brokerage received in the deal before the contract is signed.
examples.zh: 签约之前，经纪人必须披露本次交易中「已收取的全部佣金」。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for handling

examples.en: Repacking the damaged cartons added a surprising handling expense to the warehouse bill.
examples.zh: 重新包装破损纸箱，使仓储账单上多出了一笔意想不到的「搬运费用」。

examples.en: We quoted FOB precisely so the buyer would cover all handling expense at their port.
examples.zh: 我们特意按离岸价报价，好让买方承担其港口产生的全部「搬运费用」。

words.enDefinition: total proceeds before deductions

examples.en: From the gross proceeds of the auction, the gallery deducts commission before paying the artist.
examples.zh: 画廊先从拍卖「总收入」中扣除佣金，然后才向艺术家付款。

examples.en: The bond issue raised forty million in gross proceeds, before deducting underwriting fees.
examples.zh: 本次债券发行筹得「总收入」四千万美元，尚未扣除承销费用。

words.enDefinition: earnings from gross

examples.en: The bakery's gross earnings tripled after the hotel contract, yet cash still runs short.
examples.zh: 面包房拿下酒店合同后「业务总收益」翻了三倍，但现金流依然紧张。

examples.en: Before the audit, we reconciled gross earnings against the bank deposits month by month.
examples.zh: 审计之前，我们逐月核对「业务总收益」与银行进账是否一致。

words.enDefinition: a rebate granted for purchasing a larger quantity

examples.en: Order a full pallet and the wholesaler adds a five percent quantity rebate to your account.
examples.zh: 整托盘下单的话，批发商会在你的账户里计入百分之五的「批发折扣」。

examples.en: The quantity rebate only applies if all twelve containers ship within the same quarter.
examples.zh: 只有十二个货柜在同一季度内全部装运，才适用「批发折扣」。

words.enDefinition: amounts billed for overhead

examples.en: The landlord's service bill lists heating and other overhead charges separately from rent.
examples.zh: 房东的服务账单把供暖等「间接费用」与租金分开列示。

examples.en: Our tender lost out because competitors hid lower overhead charges in their pricing.
examples.zh: 我们投标失利，是因为竞争对手在报价中藏了更低的「间接费用」。

words.enDefinition: a resource controlled by an entity related to inadmitted

examples.en: The regulator made us reclassify goodwill as an inadmitted asset in the statutory return.
examples.zh: 监管机构要求我们在法定申报中把商誉重新归类为「不受保资产」。

examples.en: Because the artwork counts as an inadmitted asset, it cannot back our solvency margin.
examples.zh: 由于这批艺术品属于「不受保资产」，不能用来支撑我们的偿付能力额度。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)标准
words.enDefinition: accepted requirements for overhead expense
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)标准

examples.en: The plant finally updated its overhead expense standards after two years of rising energy prices.
examples.zh: 能源价格连涨两年之后，工厂终于更新了「制造费用标准」。

examples.en: Every quarter, cost accounting compares actual spending against the overhead expense standards.
examples.zh: 成本会计每季度都会将实际开支与「间接费用标准」进行比对。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)效率差异
words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual overhead efficiency
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)效率差异

examples.en: Most of this month's overhead efficiency variance came from the new operators learning the line.
examples.zh: 本月「制造费用效率差异」主要来自新操作工熟悉生产线的阶段。

examples.en: The supervisor questioned the overhead efficiency variance until we showed him the downtime log.
examples.zh: 直到我们出示停机记录，主管才不再质疑「制造费用效率差异」。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for overhead

examples.en: Rent, insurance, and the audit fee all sit in overhead expenses, not in direct costs.
examples.zh: 租金、保险和审计费都归入「间接费用」，不计入直接成本。

examples.en: Trimming overhead expenses halfway through a product launch usually backfires.
examples.zh: 在产品发布进行到一半时削减「间接费用」，通常适得其反。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)分摊率
words.enDefinition: a rate used to allocate overhead costs to products or cost centres
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)分摊率

examples.en: With labor hours falling, our overhead rate per machine hour has climbed sharply.
examples.zh: 随着工时减少，我们每机器小时的「制造费用分摊率」大幅上升。

examples.en: The intern computed the overhead rate from budgeted figures, which skewed the whole quote.
examples.zh: 实习生用预算数计算「制造费用分摊率」，结果整个报价都失真了。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)开支差异
words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual overhead spending
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)开支差异

examples.en: The overhead spending variance turned unfavorable once the insurance premium was renewed.
examples.zh: 保险续费之后，「制造费用开支差异」变得不利。

examples.en: A clean overhead spending variance tells me the department controlled discretionary costs well.
examples.zh: 「制造费用开支差异」干净利落，说明该部门对可控成本管得很好。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)差异
words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual overhead
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)差异

examples.en: Please break the total overhead variance into spending, efficiency, and volume pieces for the meeting.
examples.zh: 开会前请把「制造费用差异」总额拆分为开支、效率和数量三部分。

examples.en: An unfavorable overhead variance two months running is worth an investigation on the plant floor.
examples.zh: 「制造费用差异」连续两个月不利，值得下车间查一查。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)数量差异
words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual overhead volume
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)数量差异

examples.en: Because we produced fewer units than planned, the overhead volume variance came out unfavorable.
examples.zh: 由于实际产量低于计划，「制造费用数量差异」出现了不利结果。

examples.en: Management dismissed the overhead volume variance as a scheduling problem, not a cost problem.
examples.zh: 管理层认为「制造费用数量差异」只是排产问题，而非成本问题。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage operation

examples.en: The plant manager credits tight operation control for the drop in defect rates.
examples.zh: 厂长把不良率下降归功于严格的「业务管理」。

examples.en: Our ISO review found the operation control procedures were drafted but never really followed.
examples.zh: ISO 审核发现，「业务管理」程序虽已起草，却从未真正执行。

words.enDefinition: payment for goods made when they are delivered

examples.en: The courier only accepts cash on delivery, so keep exact change ready for the driver.
examples.zh: 快递员只接受「货到付款」，请备好零钱付给司机。

examples.en: Given their credit history, we will sell to them on cash on delivery terms from now on.
examples.zh: 鉴于他们的信用记录，今后我们只按「货到付款」方式与其交易。

words.enDefinition: an official authorisation or document instructing that a payment be made

examples.en: Treasury won't release the contractor's money until the project office signs the pay warrant.
examples.zh: 项目办公室在「付款授权书」上签字之前，财务部门不会向承包商放款。

examples.en: Each month the accountant prepares a pay warrant for wages and files it with the bank.
examples.zh: 会计每月编制一份工资「支付凭证」，并送交银行存档。

words.enDefinition: the statement of cost incurred in producing goods

examples.en: The bank asked for a statement of cost of production before it would extend the seasonal loan.
examples.zh: 银行要求先提供「生产成本表」，才肯发放这笔季节性贷款。

examples.en: I pulled last year's statement of cost of production to benchmark this quarter's energy usage.
examples.zh: 我调出去年的「生产成本表」，为本季度的能耗水平找参照。

collocations: prioritise the statement of cost of production
standardise the statement of cost of production
monitor the statement of cost of production

words.enDefinition: statement of cost and production; a manufacturing method or production measure

examples.en: Attach the statement of cost and production to the monthly report so the owners see both numbers.
examples.zh: 请把「产品成本及产量表」附在月报后面，让业主们同时看到两项数据。

examples.en: The consultant rebuilt our statement of cost and production after spotting a double-counted setup charge.
examples.zh: 顾问发现一笔调机费被重复计算后，重编了我们的「产品成本及产量表」。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for asset acquisition and retirement

examples.en: The board questioned the asset acquisition and retirement budget because the disposal values looked optimistic.
examples.zh: 董事会质疑「资产购置和退役预算」，因为报废残值定得过于乐观。

examples.en: We trim the asset acquisition and retirement budget every autumn before submitting the capital plan.
examples.zh: 每年秋季提交资本计划之前，我们都会先压缩「资产购置和退役预算」。

collocations: prioritise the asset acquisition and retirement budget
standardise the asset acquisition and retirement budget
monitor the asset acquisition and retirement budget

words.enDefinition: evaluation of offers and tenders to select a supplier or contractor

examples.en: The assessment of offers and tenders took longer than planned because two bids omitted the bond.
examples.zh: 由于两份投标漏交了保证金，「报价与投标的估定」比计划耗时更久。

examples.en: An independent committee handles the assessment of offers and tenders to keep the process fair.
examples.zh: 「报价与投标的估定」由独立委员会负责，以保证程序公平。

collocations: prioritise the assessment of offers and tenders
standardise the assessment of offers and tenders
monitor the assessment of offers and tenders

words.enDefinition: fluctuations concerning world market prices

examples.en: Our contract fixes the price for a year to protect both sides from fluctuations of world market prices.
examples.zh: 我们的合同锁价一年，让双方免受「世界市场价格变动」的影响。

examples.en: The commodity desk briefs the board on fluctuations of world market prices every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 商品交易团队每周一早上向董事会汇报「世界市场价格」的波动情况。

collocations: calculate the fluctuations of world market prices
compare the fluctuations of world market prices
reduce the fluctuations of world market prices

words.zhGloss: 贸易简化程序特别项目
words.enDefinition: special programme applied on trade facilitation
acceptedZhAnswers: 贸易简化程序特别项目

examples.en: Our port qualified for funding under the special programme on trade facilitation last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，我们港口获得了「贸易简化程序特别项目」的资助资格。

examples.en: Delegates debated whether the special programme on trade facilitation covers small shippers at all.
examples.zh: 代表们讨论了「贸易简化程序特别项目」是否真正惠及小型托运人。

words.enDefinition: an overall index measuring retail price changes

examples.en: Wage clauses in the contract are tied to the general index of retail prices each January.
examples.zh: 合同中的工资条款每年一月都参照「零售价格总指数」进行调整。

examples.en: The general index of retail prices climbed faster than our list prices could follow.
examples.zh: 「零售价格总指数」的上涨速度超过了我们调整价目表的速度。

collocations: calculate the general index of retail prices
compare the general index of retail prices
reduce the general index of retail prices

words.enDefinition: the risk of warehouse to warehouse

examples.en: The policy covers the risk of warehouse to warehouse, so the goods are insured door to door.
examples.zh: 保单承保「仓库至仓库险」，货物从仓到仓全程都在保障之内。

examples.en: Check whether the risk of warehouse to warehouse clause includes loading at the origin depot.
examples.zh: 请核实「仓库至仓库险」条款是否涵盖起运货场的装车环节。

collocations: inspect the risk of warehouse to warehouse
clear goods through the risk of warehouse to warehouse
stock the risk of warehouse to warehouse

words.enDefinition: agreements covering bilateral trade and payments

examples.en: The ministry renewed the bilateral trade and payments agreements before the old clearing terms expired.
examples.zh: 在旧清算条款到期之前，部里续签了「双边贸易及支付协定」。

examples.en: Settlement runs through the bilateral trade and payments agreements rather than the open market.
examples.zh: 结算通过「双边贸易及支付协定」进行，而不是走公开市场。

collocations: review the bilateral trade and payments agreements
redline the bilateral trade and payments agreements
execute the bilateral trade and payments agreements

words.enDefinition: presenting stockholders’ equity broken down by source

examples.en: The new controller insists on reporting stockholders equity by sources, which surprised several managers.
examples.zh: 新任主计长坚持「按来源列报股东权益」，让几位经理颇感意外。

examples.en: Reporting stockholders equity by sources makes it obvious how much came from retained profits.
examples.zh: 「按来源列报股东权益」之后，留存利润贡献了多少一目了然。

words.enDefinition: the cost of selling at less than

examples.en: The hardware chain is selling at less than cost to clear inventory before the lease expires.
examples.zh: 为在租约到期前清空库存，这家五金连锁店正在「蚀本出售」。

examples.en: Regulators fined the retailer for selling at less than cost to drive smaller rivals out.
examples.zh: 该零售商为挤走小对手而「蚀本出售」，被监管机构罚了款。

collocations: estimate the selling at less than cost
allocate the selling at less than cost
cut the selling at less than cost

words.zhGloss: 以销售为基础的营业收入确认法
words.enDefinition: revenue recognition on a sales basis for revenue recognition
acceptedZhAnswers: 以销售为基础的营业收入确认法

examples.en: The auditor accepted our sales basis of revenue recognition since title passes on delivery.
examples.zh: 由于所有权在交货时转移，审计师认可了我们「以销售为基础确认营业收入」的做法。

examples.en: Under the sales basis of revenue recognition, nothing is booked until the invoice is issued.
examples.zh: 按「以销售为基础的收入确认法」，开出发票之前不得入账。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit payable at a future (usance/deferred) date rather than at sight

examples.en: The seller accepted a deferred payment letter of credit to win the machinery order.
examples.zh: 卖方为拿下这台设备的订单，接受了「延期付款信用证」。

examples.en: Our bank charges a higher fee for a deferred payment letter of credit than for sight terms.
examples.zh: 与即期信用证相比，我们的银行对「延期付款信用证」收取的费用更高。

collocations: arrange the deferred payment letter of credit
monitor the deferred payment letter of credit
repay the deferred payment letter of credit

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for schedule of departmental overhead

examples.en: The reviewer flagged missing utilities in our schedule of departmental overhead costs.
examples.zh: 审核人员发现我们的「部门制造费用明细表」漏记了水电费。

examples.en: Each plant submits a schedule of departmental overhead costs before the November budget meeting.
examples.zh: 每家工厂都要在十一月预算会议之前提交「部门制造费用明细表」。

collocations: classify schedule of departmental overhead costs
measure schedule of departmental overhead costs
disclose schedule of departmental overhead costs

words.enDefinition: estate related to administrator in a bankrupt

examples.en: The court appointed an administrator in a bankrupt estate to sell the remaining inventory.
examples.zh: 法院指定了一名「破产财产管理人」来出售剩余存货。

examples.en: As administrator in a bankrupt estate, he must treat every creditor equally.
examples.zh: 作为「破产财产管理人」，他必须平等对待每一位债权人。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for types of manufacturing overhead

examples.en: The training module walks new cost clerks through the types of manufacturing overhead costs.
examples.zh: 培训模块向新任成本核算员讲解了「制造费用的种类」。

examples.en: Indirect labor and factory supplies are two familiar types of manufacturing overhead costs.
examples.zh: 间接人工和工厂物料是两类常见的「制造费用」。

collocations: classify types of manufacturing overhead costs
measure types of manufacturing overhead costs
disclose types of manufacturing overhead costs

words.enDefinition: a schedule or sheet presenting factory overhead expense distribution

examples.en: The senior accountant signed off the factory overhead expense distribution sheet before closing the books.
examples.zh: 结账之前，资深会计师在「制造费用分配表」上签了字。

examples.en: Our auditor traced every machine-hour entry back to the factory overhead expense distribution sheet.
examples.zh: 审计人员把每个机时记录都追溯到了「制造费用分配表」。

words.enDefinition: a total cost approach to distribution used in professional practice

examples.en: The textbook praises the total cost approach to distribution, but our carriers price each leg separately.
examples.zh: 教科书推崇「销售总成本法」，可我们的承运商是按每段运程分别计价的。

examples.en: Using a total cost approach to distribution, we switched from air freight to consolidated rail.
examples.zh: 运用「销售总成本法」分析后，我们把空运改成了铁路拼货。

collocations: prioritise the total cost approach to distribution
standardise the total cost approach to distribution
monitor the total cost approach to distribution

words.enDefinition: an allocation of costs to revenue used in professional practice

examples.en: The lease accounting memo explains our allocation of costs to revenue over the contract term.
examples.zh: 租赁会计备忘录解释了我们如何在合同期内「将成本分摊到收益」。

examples.en: Disputes over the allocation of costs to revenue delayed the quarterly close by two days.
examples.zh: 关于「成本对收益分配」的争议使季度结账推迟了两天。

collocations: recover the allocation of costs to revenue
allocate the allocation of costs to revenue
defer the allocation of costs to revenue

words.enDefinition: retirement of expense related to bond

examples.en: The treasurer booked the expense related to bond retirement in the period we redeemed the notes.
examples.zh: 在我们赎回票据的当期，财务主管确认了「收回公司债费用」。

examples.en: Half of the expense related to bond retirement came from the early redemption premium.
examples.zh: 「收回公司债费用」中有一半来自提前赎回的溢价。

words.enDefinition: index numbers for wholesale prices

examples.en: Economists track index numbers of wholesale prices to catch inflation before it reaches store shelves.
examples.zh: 经济学家通过「批发价格指数」在通胀传导到零售端之前捕捉苗头。

examples.en: Our annual contracts use index numbers of wholesale prices as the escalation benchmark.
examples.zh: 我们的年度合同以「批发价格指数」作为调价基准。

collocations: calculate the index numbers of wholesale prices
compare the index numbers of wholesale prices
reduce the index numbers of wholesale prices

words.enDefinition: a fundamental rule applied to cost or historical cost

examples.en: Under the cost or historical cost principle, we keep the machine at its purchase price.
examples.zh: 按照「成本或历史成本原则」，这台机器一直按购置价入账。

examples.en: The trainee asked why the cost or historical cost principle ignores today's market value.
examples.zh: 实习生问，为什么「历史成本原则」不考虑当前的市价。

words.enDefinition: an index number for retail prices

examples.en: The rent review clause is linked to the index number of retail prices published each April.
examples.zh: 租金复核条款与每年四月发布的「零售价格指数」挂钩。

examples.en: Our landlady invoked the index number of retail prices to justify the increase.
examples.zh: 房东援引「零售价格指数」来证明这次涨租有依据。

collocations: calculate the index number of retail prices
compare the index number of retail prices
reduce the index number of retail prices

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for cost of goods manufactured

examples.en: Plant accounting missed the cost of goods manufactured budget by six percent after a resin shortage.
examples.zh: 树脂短缺之后，工厂核算与「制成品成本预算」相差了百分之六。

examples.en: Finance rebuilds the cost of goods manufactured budget whenever the product mix changes materially.
examples.zh: 每当产品结构发生重大变化，财务都会重编「制成品成本预算」。

collocations: classify cost of goods manufactured budget
measure cost of goods manufactured budget
disclose cost of goods manufactured budget

words.enDefinition: the cost of goods on hand

examples.en: A physical count confirmed the cost of goods on hand at the year-end warehouse check.
examples.zh: 年终盘点时，实地清点确认了「库存商品成本」。

examples.en: Insurance asked us to declare the cost of goods on hand before renewing the policy.
examples.zh: 续保之前，保险公司要求我们申报「库存商品成本」。

collocations: classify cost of goods on hand
measure cost of goods on hand
disclose cost of goods on hand

words.enDefinition: a corporation engaged in national import and export

examples.en: The state buyer must channel all grain imports through the national import and export corporation.
examples.zh: 国家买方必须通过「国家进出口公司」办理所有粮食进口。

examples.en: Our joint venture signed a distribution deal with the national import and export corporation.
examples.zh: 我们的合资企业与「国家进出口公司」签署了一份分销协议。

collocations: calculate the national import and export corporation
compare the national import and export corporation

examples.zh: 顾问团队花了六个月把我们的「生产经营信息系统」迁到云端。

examples.zh: 出售旧货场的「资产出售收益」抵补了经营疲软的一个季度。

examples.en: Accounting keeps profit on sales of assets in a separate line so lenders see it clearly.

examples.zh: 由于面料符合「卖方样品的质量」，买方收下了这批货。

examples.zh: 放出风声说我们「正想采购」一辆二手叉车，看电话是不是马上就来。

acceptedZhAnswers: 按市场变动为准的报价

examples.zh: 交易员在邮件里说，这份报价「以市场波动为准」，我们最好今天就确认。

examples.en: The broker repeated that every offer is subject to market fluctuation, valid until Friday noon.
examples.zh: 经纪人反复强调，报价「随行就市」，有效期至周五中午。

words.zhGloss: 以领得进口许可证为准的报价

examples.zh: 我们的报价「以取得进口许可证为准」，许可证批下来才开始生产。

examples.en: Buyers hesitated because the offer subject to import license could lapse if quotas tightened.
examples.zh: 买方犹豫不决，因为这份「以进口许可证为准的报价」可能因配额收紧而失效。

words.enDefinition: the organisation of management and administration

words.enDefinition: a mutual arrangement concerning payment terms of commercial

renew the payment terms of commercial agreement
terminate the payment terms of commercial agreement

words.enDefinition: settlement of a trade transaction using a letter of credit as the payment instrument

examples.zh: 对越南供应商来说，「用信用证付款」比任何定金都更能让人安心。

examples.en: We insisted on payment with letter of credit for the first three orders.
examples.zh: 前三笔订单我们坚持「以信用证方式付款」。

words.enDefinition: relations concerning public

examples.zh: 去年秋天，她从「公共关系」岗位转到了投资者关系部门。

words.enDefinition: the views held by the public on an issue

examples.zh: 工厂关停的消息一公布，「公众舆论」便转向反对这次并购。

examples.en: The consultancy polls public opinion before any big pricing decision.
examples.zh: 在做出重大定价决策之前，咨询公司会先开展「民意」调查。

words.enDefinition: a store of department

examples.en: The downtown department store stocks our skincare line in all nine branches.
examples.zh: 市中心的「百货商店」在全部九家分店都上架了我们的护肤产品线。

examples.en: Her first job was wrapping gifts at the department store cosmetics counter.
examples.zh: 她的第一份工作是在「百货商店」化妆品柜台包装礼品。

words.enDefinition: a conference for press

examples.en: The CEO faced tough questions about layoffs at yesterday's press conference.
examples.zh: 在昨天的「记者招待会」上，首席执行官遭遇了关于裁员的尖锐提问。

examples.en: We briefed the spokesperson twice before the press conference started.
examples.zh: 「记者招待会」开始前，我们给发言人做了两次简报培训。

words.enDefinition: an up to date used in professional practice

examples.en: Please keep the delivery schedule up to date so the plant can plan shifts.
examples.zh: 请让交货时间表保持「最新状态」，方便工厂安排班次。

examples.en: The ledger is up to date through March, so the audit can start early.
examples.zh: 账簿已更新「到最近发生的业务」，审计可以提前开始了。

words.enDefinition: estate related to real

examples.en: She invests her bonus in real estate near the new metro line.
examples.zh: 她把年终奖投到了新地铁沿线的「不动产」上。

examples.en: The fund sold its real estate holdings to escape rising maintenance costs.
examples.zh: 为摆脱不断上涨的维护成本，该基金出售了旗下「不动产」。

words.zhGloss: 硬通货；强势可兑换货币

examples.en: Suppliers in Lagos often demand hard currency instead of local bank transfers.
examples.zh: 拉各斯的供应商常常要求用「硬通货」支付，而不接受本地银行转账。

examples.en: The tourism ministry rewards hotels that earn hard currency from foreign guests.
examples.zh: 旅游部门对能从外国客人身上赚取「硬通货」的酒店给予奖励。

words.enDefinition: the main editorial article in a newspaper
acceptedZhAnswers: 吸引顾客的特别廉价商品

examples.en: Her first job out of college was writing the leading article for a regional daily.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后的第一份工作，她就是为一家地方日报撰写「社论」。

examples.en: The editor's leading article this week questions whether tariffs really protect local jobs.
examples.zh: 本周编辑的「头条评论」质疑关税是否真能保护本地就业。

words.enDefinition: a review of should-be cost

examples.en: The should-be cost review flagged a spare-parts markup nobody had questioned for years.
examples.zh: 「应有成本检查」发现，备件加价问题多年无人质疑。

examples.en: Before renewing the cleaning contract, procurement ran a quick should-be cost review.
examples.zh: 续签清洁合同之前，采购部先做了一次快速的「应有成本审查」。

words.enDefinition: a system for formula cost

examples.en: Their software enforces a formula cost system, so estimates update the moment a recipe changes.
examples.zh: 他们的软件强制采用「公式成本制度」，配方一变，估算随即更新。

examples.en: The bakery's formula cost system prices every pastry from its ingredient weights.
examples.zh: 这家面包房的「公式成本制度」按配料重量为每种糕点定价。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning footage

examples.en: The rig owner insisted on a footage contract since the sandstone drills quickly.
examples.zh: 砂岩钻进速度快，钻机老板因此坚持要签「进尺合同」。

examples.en: Under our footage contract, the operator invoices only for meters actually drilled.
examples.zh: 按「进尺合同」约定，作业方只按实际钻进的米数开票。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning footage drilling

examples.en: They signed a footage drilling contract for the exploratory well in the northern basin.
examples.zh: 他们就北部盆地的探井签订了一份「钻井进尺合同」。

examples.en: Disputes over hole deviation make every footage drilling contract specify a payment formula.
examples.zh: 井斜问题容易引发纠纷，因此每份「钻井进尺合同」都写明了计价公式。

words.enDefinition: the cost of shortage

examples.en: Our shortage cost tripled once the fastest-selling SKU began selling out weekly.
examples.zh: 最畅销的单品开始周周断货后，我们的「缺货成本」翻了三倍。

examples.en: The textbook defines shortage cost as lost margin plus goodwill you never win back.
examples.zh: 教科书把「缺货成本」定义为损失的毛利加上再也挽回不了的客户好感。

words.zhGloss: 分期付款中最后一笔特大的偿还款
words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for balloon
acceptedZhAnswers: 分期付款中最后一笔特大的偿还款

examples.en: After the balloon payment clears next spring, the delivery vans finally belong to us.
examples.zh: 明春最后一笔「大额尾款」付清后，这些送货车才真正归我们所有。

examples.en: Refinancing saved us monthly cash but left a scary balloon payment in year five.
examples.zh: 再融资减轻了每月的现金压力，却在第五年留下一笔吓人的「大额尾款」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of should

examples.en: Our engineers built a should cost model for the pump housing before opening negotiations.
examples.zh: 谈判开谈之前，工程师们为泵壳建立了「应该成本」模型。

examples.en: The supplier's quote sits thirty percent above our should cost, so we pushed back.
examples.zh: 供应商的报价高出我们的「应该成本」三成，因此我们要求重新议价。

words.enDefinition: the cost of should-be

examples.en: The should-be cost for the bracket is four dollars, based on today's steel price.
examples.zh: 按今天的钢价计算，这个支架的「应有成本」是四美元。

examples.en: Auditors compare each quote with its should-be cost before signing the recommendation.
examples.zh: 审计人员先比对每个报价与其「应有成本」，然后才签署推荐意见。

words.enDefinition: management of shop

examples.en: Good shop management keeps every bench stocked before the morning shift starts.
examples.zh: 出色的「车间管理」能保证早班开工前每个工位都备好物料。

examples.en: He studied shop management at the polytechnic before joining the family foundry.
examples.zh: 进家族铸造厂之前，他在理工学院修读过「车间管理」课程。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for sliding-scale

examples.en: With a sliding-scale budget, the marketing team gains or loses funds as sales move.
examples.zh: 在「滑动预算」机制下，市场部的经费随销售业绩浮动。

examples.en: The charity runs a sliding-scale budget that expands whenever donations beat the forecast.
examples.zh: 这家慈善机构采用「浮动预算」，捐款超出预期时支出随之扩大。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for sliding-scale

examples.en: The utility charges a sliding-scale price that falls as factories consume more power.
examples.zh: 电力公司采用「浮动价格」，工厂用电越多，单价越低。

examples.en: Their sliding-scale price tracks the nickel index, so quotes last only a day.
examples.zh: 他们的「滑动价格」随镍价指数联动，报价有效期只有一天。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for footage rate

examples.en: Under footage rate payment, a stuck pipe day still costs us nothing extra.
examples.zh: 按「进尺付款」方式，卡钻停工的日子我们不用多付一分钱。

examples.en: The bank prefers footage rate payment because it ties cash outflow to progress.
examples.zh: 银行倾向于「按进尺付款」，因为资金支出与工程进度直接挂钩。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of sliding scale

examples.en: The agent earns a sliding scale commission that rises once quarterly sales pass a million.
examples.zh: 代理拿的是「累进手续费」，季度销售额过了百万，费率随之上调。

examples.en: Distributors accepted the sliding scale commission happily because volume discounts are built in.
examples.zh: 经销商欣然接受了「累进计算手续费」，因为其中内置了销量优惠。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for short-term

examples.en: Our short-term budget covers twelve months, while the strategic plan looks five years ahead.
examples.zh: 我们的「短期预算」覆盖十二个月，而战略规划则着眼于五年之后。

examples.en: Cash crunches forced the startup to redo its short-term budget twice this spring.
examples.zh: 现金流吃紧迫使这家初创公司今年春天两次重编「短期预算」。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning short sea

examples.en: Short sea trade between Baltic ports keeps our feeder vessels busy all winter.
examples.zh: 波罗的海港口之间的「短航运输」让我们的支线船整个冬天都有活干。

examples.en: Regulators promote short sea trade to take freight off the crowded motorways.
examples.zh: 监管机构鼓励「沿海短途运输」，以减轻高速公路的货运压力。

words.enDefinition: the cost of short range margin

examples.en: The plant accepts the small order because its short range margin cost stays below the bid.
examples.zh: 工厂接下这笔小订单，因为「短期边际成本」仍低于投标价。

examples.en: Economists in our pricing team plot the short range margin cost against weekly output.
examples.zh: 定价团队的经济学家把「短期边际成本」与周产量放在一起作图。

collocations: estimate the short range margin cost
allocate the short range margin cost
cut the short range margin cost

words.enDefinition: the cost of short range average

examples.en: Buying the bigger oven lowered our short range average cost per hundred loaves.
examples.zh: 换购更大的烤炉后，我们每百个面包的「短期平均成本」下降了。

examples.en: The chapter compares short range average cost curves across three plant sizes.
examples.zh: 本章对比了三种工厂规模下的「短期平均成本」曲线。

collocations: estimate the short range average cost
allocate the short range average cost
cut the short range average cost

words.zhGloss: 可避免与不可避免成本
words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for avoidable and unavoidable
acceptedZhAnswers: 可避免与不可避免成本

examples.en: The wind-down plan separates avoidable and unavoidable costs before any severance is calculated.
examples.zh: 在计算遣散费之前，退出方案先区分了「可避免成本与不可避免成本」。

examples.en: Consultants split avoidable and unavoidable costs so the board sees what closing really saves.
examples.zh: 顾问把「可避免与不可避免成本」分开列示，让董事会看清关厂究竟能省多少。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning short

examples.en: The studio prefers a short contract for each season rather than locking talent in.
examples.zh: 工作室宁愿每季签订「短期合同」，也不愿把人才长期锁死。

examples.en: A short contract keeps our options open while the pilot line proves itself.
examples.zh: 在试验线得到验证之前，「短期合同」能保住我们的选择余地。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for avoidable

examples.en: Cutting the free shuttle saved forty thousand in avoidable costs without a single complaint.
examples.zh: 取消免费班车这一项「可避免成本」，省下四万美元，且无人投诉。

examples.en: The divestment memo lists which overheads are avoidable costs and which follow the business.
examples.zh: 剥离备忘录列明了哪些是「可避免成本」，哪些会随业务一并转移。

words.enDefinition: the cost of avoidable fixed

examples.en: Closing the second canteen removes an avoidable fixed cost of nine thousand a month.
examples.zh: 关闭第二食堂可消除每月九千美元的「可避免固定成本」。

examples.en: Rent on the display hall is an avoidable fixed cost once the expo ends.
examples.zh: 展会一结束，展厅租金就成了一项「可避免的固定成本」。

words.enDefinition: a sample of shipment

examples.en: The buyer asked for a shipment sample pulled from the third pallet, not the pilot run.
examples.zh: 买方要求从第三个托盘抽取「装运样品」，而不是试产的货。

examples.en: Customs released the shipment sample quickly, so lab testing started on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 海关很快放行了「装运货物样品」，实验室测试于周二开始。

words.enDefinition: a request to arrange a shipment

examples.en: Sales submitted a shipment request for the Lagos order before the credit team approved it.
examples.zh: 信用审批尚未通过，销售部就为拉各斯订单提交了「装运申请书」。

examples.en: Each shipment request must carry the buyer's purchase order number in the header.
examples.zh: 每份「装运申请书」的表头都必须注明买方的订购单号。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in shipment transactions

examples.en: The shipment price covers inland haulage but not marine insurance.
examples.zh: 「交运价格」包含内陆运费，但不包含海运保险。

examples.en: Freight forwarders quoted wildly different shipment prices for the same ten-ton consignment.
examples.zh: 同一批十吨的货物，货代们报出的「交运价格」相差悬殊。

words.enDefinition: business activity related to small

examples.en: Her small business grew from one catering van into three school contracts.
examples.zh: 她的「小企业」从一辆餐车起步，如今拿下了三份学校供餐合同。

examples.en: The stimulus package offers tax relief specifically designed for small business employers.
examples.zh: 这项经济刺激方案为雇佣员工的「小企业」提供专门的税收减免。

words.enDefinition: a shipment of crude oil

examples.en: The storm delayed the shipment of crude by nearly a week at the loading terminal.
examples.zh: 风暴使装载码头的「原油装运」延误了近一周。

examples.en: Their tanker fleet schedules a shipment of crude every ten days through the strait.
examples.zh: 他们的油轮船队每十天安排一次经海峡的「原油装运」。

words.enDefinition: shipment made by sailing vessel

examples.en: The vineyard prefers shipment by sailing boat for its premium wines, despite the longer voyage.
examples.zh: 尽管航程更长，这家葡萄园的高级葡萄酒仍坚持「由帆船装运」。

examples.en: A shipment by sailing boat suits the furniture buyer's carbon-neutrality pledge perfectly.
examples.zh: 「帆船装运」正好契合家具买家的碳中和承诺。

collocations: prioritise the shipment by sailing boat
standardise the shipment by sailing boat
monitor the shipment by sailing boat

words.enDefinition: shipment by sailing vessel

examples.en: Grandfather's coffee house began with one shipment by sailer from the port of Hamburg.
examples.zh: 祖父的咖啡馆，就是从汉堡港的一批「帆船装运」咖啡起家的。

examples.en: Insurance surcharges apply to any shipment by sailer older than twenty years.
examples.zh: 船龄超过二十年的「帆船装运」需要加收保险附加费。

words.enDefinition: shipment delivered in instalments

examples.en: The buyer accepted shipment by instalments so its assembly line never waits on stock.
examples.zh: 买方接受「分批装运」，确保装配线不会因为等料而停工。

examples.en: Our contract allows shipment by instalments, with each batch invoiced separately.
examples.zh: 我们的合同允许「分批装运」，每批货物单独开票。

words.enDefinition: shipment made at the earliest available opportunity

examples.en: The clause says shipment by first opportunity, so we book whichever vessel calls next.
examples.zh: 条款写明「有机会即装运」，所以哪班船先到我们就订哪班。

examples.en: Since the buyer chose shipment by first opportunity, waiting days cause no demurrage.
examples.zh: 由于买方选择了「有机会即装运」，等待舱位的这几天不产生滞期费。

words.enDefinition: advice notifying that a shipment has been made

examples.en: Send the shipment advice the same day the container leaves the yard.
examples.zh: 集装箱一出堆场，当天就要发出「装运通知」。

examples.en: Without a shipment advice, the consignee's broker cannot pre-clear the goods.
examples.zh: 没有「装运通知」，收货人的报关行就无法提前清关。

words.enDefinition: the cost of shipment and delivery

examples.en: E-commerce squeezed our shipment and delivery cost by consolidating parcels at two hubs.
examples.zh: 电商业务把包裹集中到两个枢纽，压低了我们的「运送成本」。

examples.en: Customers grumble when shipment and delivery cost shows up as a separate checkout line.
examples.zh: 结账时「运输与配送费用」单独列出一行，顾客免不了抱怨。

collocations: estimate the shipment and delivery cost
allocate the shipment and delivery cost
cut the shipment and delivery cost

words.enDefinition: the cost of shipment billed above

examples.en: Intercompany policy requires any shipment billed above cost to carry a markup memo.
examples.zh: 公司内部政策规定，凡「发货计价高于成本」的，必须附上加价说明。

examples.en: The tax office questioned our shipment billed above cost between the Swiss and Polish units.
examples.zh: 税务局对瑞士子公司向波兰子公司「高于成本计价发货」提出了质疑。

collocations: estimate the shipment billed above cost
allocate the shipment billed above cost
cut the shipment billed above cost

words.enDefinition: shipment routed by the cheapest available path

examples.en: The forwarder promised a shipment by cheapest route even if it adds five days.
examples.zh: 货代承诺选择「最便宜的装运路线」，哪怕多花五天时间。

examples.en: Buyers who demand a shipment by cheapest route usually accept slower transit in writing.
examples.zh: 要求「最便宜路线装运」的买家，通常会书面接受更慢的运输时间。

words.enDefinition: shipping operations and related traffic management

examples.en: The port authority publishes monthly figures on shipping and traffic through the estuary.
examples.zh: 港口管理局每月发布河口「水陆运输」的统计数字。

examples.en: His lecture links shipping and traffic volumes to regional job growth.
examples.zh: 他的讲座把「水陆运输」的流量与区域就业增长联系起来。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for sluice-gate

examples.en: The regulator sets a sluice-gate price on imported steel to shield domestic mills.
examples.zh: 监管机构对进口钢材设置「闸门价格」，以保护国内钢厂。

examples.en: Economists argue a sluice-gate price distorts trade more than a straightforward tariff.
examples.zh: 经济学家认为，「闸门价格」比普通关税对贸易的扭曲更大。

words.zhGloss: (在合同中)规定装船期的交易
words.enDefinition: a transaction involving shipment
acceptedZhAnswers: (在合同中)规定装船期的交易

examples.en: Each shipment transaction specifies a loading window in the contract schedule.
examples.zh: 每笔「规定装船期的交易」都会在合同附表中写明装货时段。

examples.en: Delays in one shipment transaction rippled through the quarter's delivery plan.
examples.zh: 一笔「装船期交易」的延误波及了整个季度的发货计划。

words.enDefinition: conditions that govern shipped quality

examples.en: Under shipped quality terms, disputes are settled against samples taken at loading.
examples.zh: 按「装运品质条件」，品质争议以装船时抽取的样品为准解决。

examples.en: The trader prefers shipped quality terms because inspection costs fall on the buyer.
examples.zh: 贸易商偏爱「装运品质条款」，因为检验费由买方承担。

words.enDefinition: an office handling shipments from home

examples.en: The branch records shipments from home office at billed value, not at cost.
examples.zh: 分店按开票价而非成本记录「总公司发来的商品」。

examples.en: Reconciling shipments from home office took a full week after the system migration.
examples.zh: 系统迁移之后，核对「总公司运到的商品」整整花了一个星期。

collocations: secure the shipments from home office
visit the shipments from home office
lease the shipments from home office

words.enDefinition: the final stage of shipped quality

examples.en: Under shipped quality final, the loading port survey decides any quality dispute.
examples.zh: 按「以装运品质为准」，装货港的检验结果决定一切品质争议。

examples.en: We accepted shipped quality final only after the surveyor explained the sampling plan.
examples.zh: 在公证人解释了抽样方案之后，我们才接受「以装运品质为准」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of shipments billed at

examples.en: The branch profits nothing on shipments billed at cost, only on its own sales.
examples.zh: 分店在「按成本计价的发货」上不赚分文，利润只来自自营销售。

examples.en: Auditors traced shipments billed at cost between the factory and the export subsidiary.
examples.zh: 审计人员核查了工厂与出口子公司之间「按成本计价的发货」。

collocations: estimate the shipments billed at cost
allocate the shipments billed at cost
cut the shipments billed at cost

words.enDefinition: a profitability margin measuring small profit

examples.en: Grocers run on a small profit margin, so one late invoice can hurt.
examples.zh: 杂货行「利润低微」，一张发票迟付都会造成冲击。

examples.en: Fuel sellers accept a small profit margin because volume drives everything.
examples.zh: 燃油经销商接受「微薄利润」，因为一切都要靠销量说话。

words.enDefinition: the cost of average unit

examples.en: Doubling the batch size brought our average unit cost under three euros.
examples.zh: 批量翻倍后，我们的「平均单位成本」降到了三欧元以下。

examples.en: Finance flags any recipe whose average unit cost drifts five percent above target.
examples.zh: 凡是「平均单位成本」偏离目标百分之五以上的配方，财务都会标出来。

words.enDefinition: a process used for shipping

examples.en: New hires shadow the dispatcher for a week to learn our shipping process.
examples.zh: 新员工会跟着调度员见习一周，学习我们的「装运手续」。

examples.en: The checklist shortened our shipping process from six signatures to two.
examples.zh: 这份清单把「装运手续」从六个签字简化到了两个。

words.enDefinition: the cost of delayed variable

examples.en: Sales commissions are a classic delayed variable cost, paid only after customers settle.
examples.zh: 销售佣金是典型的「延期变动成本」，要等客户结清货款后才支付。

examples.en: The cash forecast treats royalties as a delayed variable cost, lagging production by a month.
examples.zh: 现金流预测把特许权使用费当作「延期变动成本」，比产量滞后一个月。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for delayed

examples.en: The supplier suspended deliveries after two delayed payments in a single quarter.
examples.zh: 一个季度内出现两笔「迟付款项」后，供应商暂停了发货。

examples.en: Interest on delayed payments accrues from the thirtieth day past the due date.
examples.zh: 「迟付款项」的利息自到期日过后第三十天起开始累计。

words.enDefinition: the cost of average variable

examples.en: When orders fall, our average variable cost per helmet rises with idle material waste.
examples.zh: 订单减少时，物料浪费使每顶头盔的「平均变动成本」上升。

examples.en: The tutor drew the average variable cost curve as a shallow U on the board.
examples.zh: 老师在黑板上把「平均变动成本」曲线画成一条浅浅的 U 形。

words.enDefinition: an average rate of profit used in professional practice

examples.en: Across the industry, the average rate of profit has settled near six percent.
examples.zh: 全行业的「平均利润率」已稳定在百分之六左右。

examples.en: Marx's chapters on the average rate of profit confused me until the seminar.
examples.zh: 直到上研讨课，我才弄懂马克思关于「平均利润率」的那几章。

collocations: prioritise the average rate of profit
standardise the average rate of profit
monitor the average rate of profit

words.enDefinition: the typical or mean quality level achieved in a production process over a period

examples.en: The new oven lifted the average quality of production without adding headcount.
examples.zh: 新烤炉在不增加人手的情况下提升了「平均产品质量」。

examples.en: Buyers judge the whole vintage by the average quality of production each season.
examples.zh: 买家以每季的「平均质量」来评判整个年份的收成。

words.enDefinition: a worker engaged in average production

examples.en: Our benchmark uses the wages of an average production worker in each region.
examples.zh: 我们的基准采用的是各地区「一般生产工人」的工资水平。

examples.en: Automation shifted the mix, so the average production worker now runs three machines.
examples.zh: 自动化改变了用工结构，「普通生产工人」如今要看管三台机器。

words.enDefinition: a unit of shipping

examples.en: The shipping unit prints labels and books pickups every afternoon at four.
examples.zh: 「运输部门」每天下午四点打印面单并预约取件。

examples.en: Complaints from retailers all traced back to one mislabeled pallet in the shipping unit.
examples.zh: 零售商的投诉全都指向「运输部门」里一件贴错标签的托盘。

words.enDefinition: conditions that govern shipping weight

examples.en: Under shipping weight terms, shortfalls discovered at destination are refunded per kilo.
examples.zh: 按「装运重量条件」，目的地发现的短重按公斤退款。

examples.en: Our buyers insist on shipping weight terms because scales at origin are unreliable.
examples.zh: 由于起运地的磅秤不可靠，买方坚持采用「装运重量条件」。

words.enDefinition: the average expected level of sales

examples.en: Recruits carry an average sales expectancy of sixty thousand a quarter.
examples.zh: 新销售每季度的「平均预期销售额」是六万美元。

examples.en: The bonus plan resets each territory's average sales expectancy every February.
examples.zh: 奖金方案每年二月都会重新设定各区域的「平均预期销售额」。

words.enDefinition: a curve showing the relationship for average revenue

examples.en: In perfect competition, the average revenue curve is simply a flat horizontal line.
examples.zh: 在完全竞争市场中，「平均收益曲线」就是一条平直的水平线。

examples.en: The tutor sketched the average revenue curve beside the demand curve to show they coincide.
examples.zh: 辅导老师把「平均收益曲线」画在需求曲线旁边，说明两者重合。

words.enDefinition: the final stage of shipping weight

examples.en: The contract is settled on shipping weight final, so claims end at the loading port.
examples.zh: 合同按「以装运重量为准」结算，索赔在装货港即告终结。

examples.en: Because we agreed shipping weight final, moisture loss at sea is our buyer's problem.
examples.zh: 由于约定了「装运重量为准」，海运中的水分损耗由买方承担。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from average

examples.en: Dividing total takings by tickets sold gives the cinema's average revenue per viewer.
examples.zh: 总票房除以售票数，就得到这家影院每位观众的「平均收益」。

examples.en: Farmers watched average revenue per hectare shrink as grain prices slid.
examples.zh: 随着粮价下滑，农民眼看着每公顷「平均收益」不断缩水。

words.enDefinition: dispatch of goods from the mill

examples.en: Shipping from the mill starts Monday, so the first trucks reach Milan by Thursday.
examples.zh: 「工厂交货」从周一开始，第一批货车周四就能抵达米兰。

examples.en: Buyers who arrange their own haulage save on shipping from the mill.
examples.zh: 自行安排运输的买家能省下「工厂交货」的相关费用。

collocations: prioritise the shipping from the mill
standardise the shipping from the mill
monitor the shipping from the mill

words.enDefinition: a firm dealing in shipping

examples.en: The old shipping house on the quay now hosts a maritime museum.
examples.zh: 码头边那座老「船公司」大楼如今成了一家海事博物馆。

examples.en: Grandfather clerked for a shipping house that ran timber routes to Riga.
examples.zh: 祖父曾在一家经营里加木材航线的「船公司」做文书。

words.enDefinition: amounts billed for shipping

examples.en: Our quotation excludes shipping charges, which the freight desk bills separately.
examples.zh: 我们的报价不含「装船费用」，运费由货运台另行开具。

examples.en: Disputed shipping charges on the March consignment are still with the carrier.
examples.zh: 三月份那批货的「装运费用」争议仍未与承运人了结。

words.enDefinition: an entrepreneur engaged in shipping

examples.en: The young shipping entrepreneur bought her first coaster with a loan from her uncle.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的「航运企业家」靠叔叔的贷款买下了第一艘近海货轮。

examples.en: Local papers profiled the shipping entrepreneur who revived the dormant ferry line.
examples.zh: 当地报纸报道了这位重启停摆渡轮航线的「航运企业家」。

words.enDefinition: a contractual provision about shipping

examples.en: The shipping clause names Rotterdam and forbids transshipment through congested hubs.
examples.zh: 「装运条款」指定鹿特丹，并禁止经由拥堵枢纽转运。

examples.en: Our lawyer redlined the shipping clause because the laycan window was too tight.
examples.zh: 因受载期定得过紧，律师修改了「装运条款」。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with shipping

examples.en: The shipping company refunds freight when vessels miss the agreed arrival window.
examples.zh: 如果船舶错过约定的到港时间，这家「航运公司」会退还运费。

examples.en: She left a logistics role at a shipping company to join the port authority.
examples.zh: 她辞去一家「航运公司」的物流岗位，转投港务局。

words.enDefinition: documents used for shipping

examples.en: The bank releases the shipping documents only after the importer accepts the draft.
examples.zh: 进口商承兑汇票后，银行才会交出「装运单据」。

examples.en: Missing stamps on the shipping documents delayed the release of our cargo.
examples.zh: 「装运单据」上缺少印章，导致我们的货物滞留。

words.enDefinition: an enterprise engaged in shipping

examples.en: Every shipping enterprise in the alliance must adopt the same emissions reporting format.
examples.zh: 联盟内的每家「航运企业」都必须采用统一的排放报告格式。

examples.en: The state seeded the shipping enterprise with two aging ferries and a loan.
examples.zh: 国家以两艘旧渡轮和一笔贷款扶持了这家「航运企业」。

words.enDefinition: a demand for payment related to shipping

examples.en: We lodged a shipping claim for the crates that arrived water-stained.
examples.zh: 对到货时被水浸的木箱，我们提出了「装运索赔」。

examples.en: A shipping claim against the carrier must cite the bill of lading number.
examples.zh: 向承运人提起「装运索赔」时必须注明提单号。

words.enDefinition: an explanatory disclosure related to shipping

examples.en: The driver left with a signed shipping note and two copies for the depot.
examples.zh: 司机带着已签字的「装运通知单」和两份副本出发前往货场。

examples.en: Warehouse staff will not load a truck without an approved shipping note.
examples.zh: 没有经批准的「装运通知单」，仓库员工不会装车。

words.enDefinition: a notice concerning shipping

examples.en: Retailers receive an automated shipping notice the moment each parcel leaves the depot.
examples.zh: 包裹一离开发货仓，零售商就会收到自动推送的「装运通知」。

examples.en: The shipping notice arrives by email, but claims still need the paper original.
examples.zh: 「装运通知」通过邮件送达，但索赔仍需纸质原件。

words.enDefinition: yield earned from average

examples.en: The bond desk quotes an average yield of four point two across the ladder.
examples.zh: 债券台报价显示，这组债券的「平均收益」为百分之四点二。

examples.en: Retirees compare the fund's average yield with what the bank deposit pays.
examples.zh: 退休人员会把基金的「平均收益」与银行存款利息作比较。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of del credere

examples.en: The agent charges a del credere commission for guaranteeing the buyers' payments.
examples.zh: 因担保买方付款，代理人收取「保付货款佣金」。

examples.en: With a del credere commission in place, our factor absorbs any bad debt.
examples.zh: 由于支付了「保付货款佣金」，任何坏账都由保理商承担。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for delay in

examples.en: A short delay in payment is tolerable, but forty-five days strains the supplier.
examples.zh: 稍微「延期支付」尚可接受，但拖上四十五天会让供应商吃不消。

examples.en: The contract levies interest for any delay in payment beyond the due date.
examples.zh: 合同规定，凡超过到期日的「延期支付」都要计收利息。

words.enDefinition: marks on packages identifying a shipment

examples.en: Each crate carries the shipping mark our consignee printed in the booking confirmation.
examples.zh: 每个木箱都刷有收货人在订舱确认件中指定的「装运标志」。

examples.en: A smudged shipping mark left one pallet circling the terminal for two days.
examples.zh: 一处模糊的「装运标志」让一件托盘在码头多滞留了两天。

words.enDefinition: a line of shipping

examples.en: The shipping line added a second weekly call at Tangier this summer.
examples.zh: 今夏这家「航运公司」在丹吉尔增挂了每周第二个航次。

examples.en: Freight rates soften whenever the big shipping lines add capacity.
examples.zh: 大型「航运公司」一增加运力，运价就会走软。

words.enDefinition: a survey of conditions in a foreign market

examples.en: Their foreign market survey warned that Japanese buyers prefer longer payment terms.
examples.zh: 他们的「国外市场调查」提醒说，日本买家偏好更长的付款周期。

examples.en: Before opening the Berlin office, we commissioned a foreign market survey.
examples.zh: 开设柏林办事处之前，我们委托做了一份「国外市场调查」。

words.enDefinition: the worth assigned to foreign market

examples.en: Customs compares the export price with the foreign market value to check for dumping.
examples.zh: 海关将出口价格与「国外市场价值」比对，以核查是否存在倾销。

examples.en: The appeal hinged on how the appraiser computed the foreign market value.
examples.zh: 上诉的焦点在于估价师如何计算「国外市场价值」。

words.enDefinition: management of bad

examples.en: The factory closed, and everyone blamed bad management rather than the union.
examples.zh: 工厂倒闭了，大家都归咎于「经营不善」，而不是工会。

examples.en: Years of bad management left the retailer with shelves nobody wanted.
examples.zh: 多年的「经营不善」让这家零售商的货架上堆满了没人要的货。

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for foreign commission

examples.en: We export through a foreign commission agent who handles all South American paperwork.
examples.zh: 我们通过一位「外国佣金代理」出口，南美的单证全由他经手。

examples.en: The foreign commission agent earns two percent plus a share of freight savings.
examples.zh: 这位「外国佣金代理」收取百分之二的佣金，外加运费节省的分成。

words.enDefinition: work performed related to foreign commercial

examples.en: The trade attache at the foreign commercial service arranged our embassy introductions.
examples.zh: 「商务外事司」的商务参赞为我们安排了使馆方面的引荐。

examples.en: Her posting with the foreign commercial service took her from Lagos to Hanoi.
examples.zh: 在「商务外事司」的任职让她从拉各斯走到了河内。

words.enDefinition: a basic or limited letter-of-credit facility used in trade finance

examples.en: For this small order, a simple credit from their bank is enough security.
examples.zh: 这笔小额订单，对方银行开立的「简单信用证」作担保就足够了。

examples.en: The clerk prefers a simple credit because unconfirmed ones avoid the confirmation fee.
examples.zh: 经办员喜欢「简单信用证」，不保兑就省下了保兑费。

words.enDefinition: accepted requirements for forecast cost

examples.en: The pricing committee reviews forecast cost standards before every January list price.
examples.zh: 每年一月价目表出台前，定价委员会都会审阅「预测成本准则」。

examples.en: Our forecast cost standards assume energy stays flat through the second quarter.
examples.zh: 我们的「预测成本准则」假定能源价格在二季度之前保持平稳。

words.enDefinition: an operation involving simulated management

examples.en: Students run a simulated management operation for a virtual factory each semester.
examples.zh: 学生每学期都要为一家虚拟工厂开展「模拟管理作业」。

examples.en: The airline trains dispatchers through a simulated management operation with scripted crises.
examples.zh: 航空公司通过带有预设危机的「模拟管理作业」培训签派员。

words.enDefinition: orders accepted but not yet filled

examples.en: The backlog of unfilled orders stretched to eleven weeks before we hired the second crew.
examples.zh: 在雇用第二个班组之前，「未完成订单」已经排到了十一个星期。

examples.en: Investors read the backlog of unfilled orders as a signal that demand is still firm.
examples.zh: 投资者把「未完成订单」的积压解读为需求依然坚挺的信号。

collocations: issue the backlog of unfilled orders
review the backlog of unfilled orders

words.enDefinition: sites used for customs inspection

examples.en: The manifest lists three approved sites of customs inspection near the border crossing.
examples.zh: 载货清单列出了边境口岸附近三个经批准的「验关地点」。

examples.en: Traders complained that moving the sites of customs inspection added a whole day.
examples.zh: 商家抱怨，「验关地点」一挪，整个流程就多了一天。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning sino-foreign

examples.en: Her dissertation tracks sino-foreign trade from the early 1980s onward.
examples.zh: 她的论文追踪了二十世纪八十年代初以来的「中外贸易」。

examples.en: The chamber publishes quarterly bulletins on sino-foreign trade arbitration cases.
examples.zh: 商会每季度发布「中外贸易」仲裁案例简报。

words.enDefinition: a wholesaler of single line

examples.en: As a single line wholesaler, they stock nothing but industrial fasteners.
examples.zh: 作为「专业批发商」，他们只经营工业紧固件这一类商品。

examples.en: Retailers trust a single line wholesaler to know the category inside out.
examples.zh: 零售商相信「单一品类批发商」对自己经手的品类了如指掌。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for single

examples.en: The landlord wants a single payment for the year, not monthly transfers.
examples.zh: 房东要求整年租金「一次性支付」，不接受按月转账。

examples.en: We settled the equipment bill with a single payment to keep the ledger clean.
examples.zh: 我们用「一笔付清」的方式结算设备账单，让账目清爽些。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in single transactions

examples.en: The bazaar stall sells every ornament at a single price of five dollars.
examples.zh: 集市摊位上的所有饰品都按五美元的「单一价格」出售。

examples.en: Economists still debate whether a single price for water is ever fair.
examples.zh: 对水实行「单一价格」是否公平，经济学家仍有争论。

words.enDefinition: the cost of back-stopping

examples.en: The agency's back-stopping cost covers specialist advice whenever field teams get stuck.
examples.zh: 该机构的「支助费用」用于在一线团队遇到难题时聘请专家支援。

examples.en: Donors questioned the back-stopping cost line until the coordinator explained the experts' role.
examples.zh: 直到协调员说明专家的角色，捐助方才不再质疑「支助费用」科目。

words.enDefinition: a system for single cost

examples.en: Running a single cost system across both plants simplified the annual audit.
examples.zh: 两家工厂共用一套「单一成本制」，年度审计因此简单了不少。

examples.en: They abandoned job costing for a single cost system once products converged.
examples.zh: 产品趋于同质后，他们放弃了分批成本法，改用「单一成本制」。

words.enDefinition: a document used in single customs

examples.en: The single customs document lets one filing clear goods across all member states.
examples.zh: 凭这份「单一海关单据」，一次申报就能让货物在所有成员国通关。

examples.en: Filling in the single customs document took the intern nearly an hour.
examples.zh: 实习生填写这份「单一海关单据」花了将近一个小时。

words.enDefinition: a memo recording a back order

examples.en: The clerk raised a back order memo for the twelve switches still owing.
examples.zh: 库管员为仍缺的十二个开关开出了「延期交货通知单」。

examples.en: Every back order memo must state the promised ship date in bold.
examples.zh: 每份「延期交货通知单」都必须用粗体注明承诺发货日期。

words.enDefinition: the record of a country’s transactions with the rest of the world

examples.en: The treasury monitors the balance of external payments before easing import restrictions.
examples.zh: 财政部在放宽进口限制之前会先监测「对外支付差额」。

examples.en: Oil receipts turned the country's balance of external payments positive again.
examples.zh: 石油收入使该国「对外支付差额」重新转为顺差。

collocations: prioritise the balance of external payments
standardise the balance of external payments
monitor the balance of external payments

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for force

examples.en: The court order allows force payment from the debtor's frozen account.
examples.zh: 法院裁定允许从债务人的冻结账户「强制付款」。

examples.en: Collectors may request force payment only after two formal demand letters.
examples.zh: 催收方只有在发出两次正式催告后才能申请「强制扣款」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in forecast transactions

examples.en: Our tender assumed a forecast price of ninety dollars a barrel for the season.
examples.zh: 投标时我们按每桶九十美元的「预测价格」估算全季成本。

examples.en: The ministry publishes a forecast price for electricity every quarter.
examples.zh: 该部门每季度发布一次电力的「预测价格」。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning balance of invisible

examples.en: Tourism earnings lifted the balance of invisible trade into surplus for the first time.
examples.zh: 旅游收入使「无形贸易收支差额」首次转为顺差。

examples.en: Shipping fees dominate the country's balance of invisible trade accounts.
examples.zh: 航运收入在该国「无形贸易收支差额」中占主导地位。

words.enDefinition: a review of should-cost

examples.en: The should-cost review revealed the vendor was quoting premium freight on every box.
examples.zh: 「应有成本审查」发现，供应商对每箱货都按加急运费报价。

examples.en: Engineers and buyers jointly run a should-cost review before any renewal above fifty thousand.
examples.zh: 凡超过五万美元的续约，工程师和采购都会联合进行「应有成本审查」。

words.enDefinition: a reduction in available production capacity

examples.en: Power rationing caused a noticeable shrinkage of production capacity across the district.
examples.zh: 限电导致该地区「生产能力收缩」，降幅明显。

examples.en: The report links the shrinkage of production capacity to retiring blast furnaces.
examples.zh: 报告将「产能收缩」与老旧高炉的退役联系在一起。

collocations: improve the shrinkage of production capacity
measure the shrinkage of production capacity
benchmark the shrinkage of production capacity

words.enDefinition: the cost of shut-down

examples.en: Board members underestimated the shut-down cost, from severance to environmental closure.
examples.zh: 从遣散费到环保封场，董事会成员低估了「停产成本」。

examples.en: Accounting spreads the shut-down cost over the final operating quarters.
examples.zh: 会计把「停产成本」分摊到最后几个经营季度。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in delivery transactions

examples.en: The futures contract settles at the delivery price fixed on the last trading day.
examples.zh: 期货合约按最后交易日确定的「交割价格」结算。

examples.en: Traders hedge better when the delivery price tracks the physical market closely.
examples.zh: 「交割价格」越贴近现货市场，交易商的套期保值就越有效。

words.enDefinition: a balance of profit used in professional practice

examples.en: After the provisions, the balance of profit carried forward stood at eight million.
examples.zh: 计提准备之后，结转的「利润余额」为八百万。

examples.en: The partnership deed splits the balance of profit three ways each December.
examples.zh: 合伙契约规定每年十二月将「利润余额」按三份分配。

words.enDefinition: a balance of trade used in professional practice

examples.en: Exporters cheered as the balance of trade swung into surplus last month.
examples.zh: 上月「贸易差额」转为顺差，出口商们为之欢呼。

examples.en: Analysts expect the balance of trade to worsen once import duties fall.
examples.zh: 分析人士预计，进口关税下调后「贸易差额」会恶化。

words.enDefinition: an avoidance of the contract used in professional practice

examples.en: The buyer notified avoidance of the contract within the ten-day window.
examples.zh: 买方在十天期限内通知「宣告合同无效」。

examples.en: Fraud in the certificate of origin justified avoidance of the contract outright.
examples.zh: 原产地证书造假使「宣告合同无效」有了完全正当的理由。

collocations: draft the avoidance of the contract
sign the avoidance of the contract
enforce the avoidance of the contract

words.enDefinition: an away from the market used in professional practice

examples.en: The broker warned that our bid sat far away from the market clearing level.
examples.zh: 经纪人提醒，我们的出价「不照市价」，与成交水平相去甚远。

examples.en: Orders priced away from the market simply sit there until someone cancels them.
examples.zh: 「偏离市价」的挂单只会一直挂着，直到有人撤销。

collocations: secure the away from the market
visit the away from the market
lease the away from the market

words.zhGloss: 根据和解作出的仲裁裁决
words.enDefinition: the completion of payment or delivery for award upon
acceptedZhAnswers: 根据和解作出的仲裁裁决

examples.en: The tribunal recorded an award upon settlement after both parties split the disputed sum.
examples.zh: 双方分摊争议金额后，仲裁庭作出了「根据和解的裁决」。

examples.en: Counsel confirmed the award upon settlement is final and needs no appeal.
examples.zh: 律师确认，「和解裁决」为终局裁决，无需上诉。

words.enDefinition: an award of contract used in professional practice

examples.en: The award of contract came by email, two days before the president's visit.
examples.zh: 「合同授予」的通知在总统到访前两天通过邮件送达。

examples.en: Losing bidders may request the reasons behind the award of contract in writing.
examples.zh: 未中标的投标方可书面索取「授予合同」的理由说明。

words.enDefinition: a budget in which planned revenue exceeds planned spending, leaving money available for other uses

examples.en: The county presented a balanced budget with surplus funds earmarked for road repairs.
examples.zh: 该县提交了一份「有盈余的预算」，结余资金专用于道路维修。

examples.en: Voters approved the balanced budget with surplus after two years of deficits.
examples.zh: 经历两年赤字之后，选民批准了这份「略有盈余的预算」。

collocations: plan a balanced budget with surplus revenue

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for balanced

examples.en: The charter requires a balanced budget, so shortfall months trigger spending freezes.
examples.zh: 章程要求「预算平衡」，因此收入不济的月份会触发支出冻结。

examples.en: She fought for a balanced budget even as cabinet colleagues pushed new programs.
examples.zh: 尽管内阁同僚力推新项目，她仍坚持「平衡预算」。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning formal

examples.en: The handshake deal became a formal contract once legal reviewed the terms.
examples.zh: 法务审核条款之后，这笔口头交易变成了「正式合同」。

examples.en: No formal contract exists, so the tribunal weighs emails and purchase orders.
examples.zh: 由于没有「正式契约」，仲裁庭只能依据往来邮件和订购单裁量。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with forest

examples.en: The province revalues its forest capital every decade using standing timber surveys.
examples.zh: 该省每十年依据立木调查对「森林资产」重新估值。

examples.en: Sustainable leases treat forest capital as an asset that must never shrink.
examples.zh: 可持续租赁把「森林资产」视为绝不能缩水的资产。

words.enDefinition: a forestall the market used in professional practice

examples.en: Regulators accused the grain trader of trying to forestall the market before harvest.
examples.zh: 监管机构指控这家粮食交易商试图在收获季之前「垄断市场」。

examples.en: Cornering the crop to forestall the market drew fines and a trading ban.
examples.zh: 囤积作物「操纵市场」的行为招致罚款和交易禁令。

words.enDefinition: a form of budget used in professional practice

examples.en: The ministry standardized the form of budget so departments stop inventing their own columns.
examples.zh: 部里统一了「预算格式」，各部门不再自行设计栏目。

examples.en: Her template became the form of budget used across the whole group.
examples.zh: 她做的模板成了整个集团通用的「预算格式」。

words.enDefinition: the legal form in which a business is organised

examples.en: Lawyers helped them pick a form of business enterprise that shields personal savings.
examples.zh: 律师帮他们选择了能保护个人积蓄的「企业类型」。

examples.en: The chapter contrasts each form of business enterprise by liability and tax treatment.
examples.zh: 本章从责任和税务角度对比各种「企业类型」。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning form

examples.en: The landlord handed over a form contract with barely a blank to fill.
examples.zh: 房东递来一份「标准合同」，几乎没什么空格可填。

examples.en: Our legal team tailored the form contract for cross-border equipment leases.
examples.zh: 法务团队把「格式合同」改造成了适合跨境设备租赁的版本。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning foreign

examples.en: The port's fortunes rise and fall with the country's foreign trade.
examples.zh: 这个港口的兴衰与国家「对外贸易」息息相关。

examples.en: Foreign trade grew seven percent despite freight rates staying stubbornly high.
examples.zh: 尽管运费居高不下，「对外贸易」仍增长了百分之七。

words.enDefinition: selling activity or proceeds related to forecasting

examples.en: Forecasting sales for the holiday quarter starts with last year's weekly pattern.
examples.zh: 「销售预测」从参照去年每周的节奏做起，为节日季度做准备。

examples.en: Her forecasting sales model flagged the dip two weeks before it hit.
examples.zh: 她的「销售预测」模型在下滑出现前两周就发出了预警。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage foreign trade

examples.en: Exporters must screen every shipment against the country's foreign trade control lists.
examples.zh: 出口商必须对照国家「对外贸易管制」清单筛查每批货物。

examples.en: The seminar explains how foreign trade control affects dual-use equipment orders.
examples.zh: 研讨会讲解了「外贸管制」对两用设备订单的影响。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for forecast-type

examples.en: Their forecast-type budget rolls forward each month instead of resetting every January.
examples.zh: 他们的「预测式预算」按月滚动更新，而不是每年一月重新来过。

examples.en: Startups often prefer a forecast-type budget because fixed annual targets age badly.
examples.zh: 初创公司往往偏爱「预测型预算」，因为固定的年度目标很快就过时。

words.enDefinition: a corporation engaged in foreign trade

examples.en: The state foreign trade corporation still controls exports of rare earth concentrates.
examples.zh: 这家国有「外贸公司」仍掌控稀土精矿的出口。

examples.en: Grandfather retired from a foreign trade corporation after thirty years of tea shipments.
examples.zh: 祖父做了三十年茶叶出口后，从一家「外贸公司」退休。

words.enDefinition: a forecasting of profit used in professional practice

examples.en: The bank questioned our forecasting of profit because it ignored currency swings.
examples.zh: 银行质疑我们的「利润预测」，因为它忽略了汇率波动。

examples.en: Analysts reconcile each forecasting of profit against last year's actual margins.
examples.zh: 分析师会用去年的实际利润率来校验每一份「利润预测」。

words.enDefinition: an economic multiplier that measures the effect of foreign trade

examples.en: Lecturers used the foreign trade multiplier to show how exports ripple through incomes.
examples.zh: 讲师用「对外贸易乘数」说明出口如何在收入层面层层传导。

examples.en: A higher foreign trade multiplier makes small export gains matter enormously.
examples.zh: 「对外贸易乘数」越大，小幅出口增长的影响就越可观。

words.enDefinition: a forecasting of cost used in professional practice

examples.en: Forecasting of cost begins with the steel index, then adds conversion labor.
examples.zh: 「成本预测」从钢材指数入手，再加上加工人工费用。

examples.en: Their forecasting of cost missed the packaging inflation that hit in August.
examples.zh: 他们的「成本预测」漏掉了八月突袭而来的包装涨价。

words.enDefinition: a consignment of foreign trade on

examples.en: The firm ships leather goods to Latin buyers under foreign trade on consignment terms.
examples.zh: 该公司以「寄售方式的对外贸易」向拉美买家发货。

examples.en: Unsold stock returns under foreign trade on consignment, so risk stays with the exporter.
examples.zh: 「寄售外贸」中未售出的货物可以退回，风险因此留在出口商这边。

collocations: schedule the foreign trade on consignment
document the foreign trade on consignment
insure the foreign trade on consignment

words.enDefinition: a stated policy or approach governing foreign trade

examples.en: The chamber briefed members on how the new foreign trade policy affects tariffs.
examples.zh: 商会向会员讲解了新「对外贸易政策」对关税的影响。

examples.en: Her ministry drafts foreign trade policy jointly with the customs bureau.
examples.zh: 她所在的部与海关总署共同起草「对外贸易政策」。

words.enDefinition: a structure of foreign trade

examples.en: Electronics now dominate the country's foreign trade structure, overtaking textiles.
examples.zh: 电子产品已超越纺织品，在该国「对外贸易商品结构」中居首。

examples.en: Economists chart the foreign trade structure to spot over-reliance on one commodity.
examples.zh: 经济学家绘制「对外贸易商品结构」图，以发现对单一商品的过度依赖。

words.enDefinition: a zone where goods may be imported with special customs treatment

examples.en: Distributors warehouse goods duty-free inside the foreign trade zone near the airport.
examples.zh: 经销商在机场附近的「对外贸易区」内免税仓储货物。

examples.en: Assembling kits inside a foreign trade zone delays customs duty until delivery.
examples.zh: 在「对外贸易区」内组装套件，可以把关税递延到交货时再缴。

words.enDefinition: a board that oversees foreign trade zones

examples.en: The foreign trade zones board granted our application after an eighteen-month review.
examples.zh: 经过十八个月的审查，「对外贸易区委员会」批准了我们的申请。

examples.en: Appeals from the foreign trade zones board go straight to federal court.
examples.zh: 对「对外贸易区委员会」裁决的申诉直接提交联邦法院。

words.enDefinition: relations concerning foreign trade

examples.en: Sanctions talks chilled the two countries' foreign trade relations for a whole year.
examples.zh: 制裁谈判使两国的「对外贸易关系」整整冷了一年。

examples.en: The treaty aims to normalize foreign trade relations between the neighboring states.
examples.zh: 该条约旨在使邻国之间的「对外贸易关系」正常化。

words.enDefinition: a delivered to order used in professional practice

examples.en: The wine leaves the cellar only delivered to order, never on speculation.
examples.zh: 这些葡萄酒只在「按定货单交货」时出窖，从不投机备货。

examples.en: Warehouse staff scan each pallet to confirm it is delivered to order.
examples.zh: 仓管员逐一扫描托盘，确认货物是「按订购单交付」的。

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for delivery and customs

examples.en: Our delivery and customs agent clears the machines at the border in two days.
examples.zh: 我们的「提货报关代理人」两天内就在边境为设备清了关。

examples.en: Freight forwarders now bundle brokerage, acting as delivery and customs agent in one.
examples.zh: 如今货代把报关业务打包，同时充当「提货报关代理人」。

collocations: appoint a delivery and customs agent
issue the delivery and customs agent
review the delivery and customs agent

words.enDefinition: a bank’s conditional undertaking to pay a beneficiary when stipulated documents are presented (letter of credit)

examples.en: The supplier accepted a sight letter of credit instead of asking for prepayment.
examples.zh: 供应商接受了「即期信用证」，没有要求预付款。

examples.en: Under a sight letter of credit, the bank pays as soon as documents comply.
examples.zh: 在「即期信用证」项下，只要单证相符，银行立即付款。

collocations: arrange the sight letter of credit
monitor the sight letter of credit
repay the sight letter of credit

words.enDefinition: orders related to standing expense

examples.en: The accountant files standing expense orders for rent, insurance, and software licenses.
examples.zh: 会计把房租、保险和软件授权的「经常费用单」归档。

examples.en: Standing expense orders let treasury pay recurring bills without fresh approvals.
examples.zh: 有「经常费用单」在手，财务支付经常性账单时无需再走审批。

words.enDefinition: the cost of standing

examples.en: Even with the line idle, standing cost keeps burning about ten thousand a week.
examples.zh: 就算生产线闲置，「常备成本」每周也要烧掉大约一万美元。

examples.en: The pricing floor must cover standing cost before any variable margin.
examples.zh: 定价底线必须先覆盖「固定维持成本」，然后才谈变动毛利。

words.enDefinition: a bank’s conditional undertaking to pay a beneficiary when stipulated documents are presented (letter of credit)

examples.en: The landlord insists on a standby letter of credit covering six months of rent.
examples.zh: 房东坚持要求提供担保六个月租金的「备用信用证」。

examples.en: We never drew the standby letter of credit, but it calmed the landlord.
examples.zh: 「备用信用证」虽然从未动用，却让房东安心不少。

collocations: arrange the standby letter of credit
monitor the standby letter of credit
repay the standby letter of credit

words.zhGloss: (联合成本计算的)标准收获量法
words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling standard yield
acceptedZhAnswers: (联合成本计算的)标准收获量法

examples.en: The dairy allocates joint costs by the standard yield method for butter and cream.
examples.zh: 乳品厂用「标准收获量法」在黄油和奶油之间分摊联合成本。

examples.en: Under the standard yield method, output is priced at its normal recovery rate.
examples.zh: 按「标准收获量法」，产出按正常收得率计价。

words.enDefinition: an enterprise engaged in associated

examples.en: Transfer pricing rules apply to every sale between us and any associated enterprise.
examples.zh: 转让定价规则适用于我们与任何「关联企业」之间的销售。

examples.en: The audited accounts list each associated enterprise with its country of incorporation.
examples.zh: 经审计的报表列出了每一家「联合企业」及其注册国。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for standard purchase

examples.en: Buyers quote against the standard purchase price set each October.
examples.zh: 采购员按每年十月设定的「标准购入价格」对外询价。

examples.en: Variance reports compare every invoice to the standard purchase price for the item.
examples.zh: 差异报告把每张发票与该物料的「标准采购价格」作对比。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from standard

examples.en: The group's standard profit per unit assumes the normal scrap rate, not the bad one.
examples.zh: 集团的单位「标准利润」按正常报废率计算，而非当前的糟糕水平。

examples.en: Performance bonuses hinge on beating standard profit, not just on total sales.
examples.zh: 绩效奖金取决于能否超越「标准利润」，而不仅仅是总销售额。

words.enDefinition: a card used for standard product cost

examples.en: Every engineer signs the standard product cost card before the pilot build starts.
examples.zh: 试产开始之前，每位工程师都要在「标准产品成本卡」上签字。

examples.en: The cost clerk spotted the missing gasket on the standard product cost card.
examples.zh: 成本核算员在「标准产品成本卡」上发现了漏掉的垫圈。

collocations: sign the standard product cost card
attach the standard product cost card
archive the standard product cost card

words.enDefinition: the cost of standard product

examples.en: Standard product cost for the chair rose after oak prices jumped in spring.
examples.zh: 春季橡木价格跳涨后，这把椅子的「标准产品成本」随之上升。

examples.en: Marketing sets list prices by adding margin to standard product cost.
examples.zh: 市场部在「标准产品成本」基础上加成定价。

words.enDefinition: a schedule or sheet presenting standard process cost

examples.en: Each refining stage carries its own line on the standard process cost sheet.
examples.zh: 「标准分步成本单」上为每个精炼工序单独列行。

examples.en: The audit compared machine hours against the standard process cost sheet hour by hour.
examples.zh: 审计人员逐小时核对了机器工时与「标准分步成本单」。

collocations: prioritise the standard process cost sheet
standardise the standard process cost sheet
monitor the standard process cost sheet

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling standard price

examples.en: Under the standard price method, purchasing variances surface the moment goods arrive.
examples.zh: 采用「标准价格法」，货物一入库就能暴露采购差异。

examples.en: The textbook explains the standard price method with a simple valve example.
examples.zh: 教材用一个简单的阀门例子讲解「标准价格法」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in standard transactions

examples.en: The standard price for copper fittings updates on the first Monday of each month.
examples.zh: 铜配件的「标准价格」每月第一个周一更新。

examples.en: Shop floor variances arise when actual metal prices drift from the standard price.
examples.zh: 实际金属价格偏离「标准价格」时，车间就会产生差异。

words.enDefinition: the cost of standard material

examples.en: The standard material cost for one shirt assumes 1.9 meters of cotton.
examples.zh: 一件衬衫的「标准材料成本」按一点九米棉布计算。

examples.en: Recipe changes need approval whenever they move the standard material cost by two percent.
examples.zh: 凡使「标准材料成本」变动超过百分之二的配方调整，都需经审批。

words.enDefinition: manufacture of standard

examples.en: The lab certifies each batch as standard manufacture before it ships to distributors.
examples.zh: 每批产品发运给经销商之前，实验室都按「标准制造」要求予以认证。

examples.en: Deviating from standard manufacture voids the warranty on the compressor line.
examples.zh: 偏离「标准制造」工艺，压缩机生产线的质保即告失效。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for standard legal

examples.en: Pharmacies must dispense the medicine at the standard legal price set by decree.
examples.zh: 药房必须按法令规定的「标准法定价格」配售该药品。

examples.en: The tender evaluates bids against the standard legal price for public works.
examples.zh: 招标评审以公共工程的「标准法定价格」作为比价基准。

words.enDefinition: quality measures for standard

examples.en: The mill guarantees standard quality across every lot of Grade A fabric.
examples.zh: 这家工厂保证每批 A 级面料都达到「标准质量」。

examples.en: Inspectors rejected the drums whose finish fell below standard quality.
examples.zh: 检验员拒收了表面处理低于「标准质量」的桶件。

words.enDefinition: the cost of standard unit

examples.en: Purchasing celebrates whenever the standard unit cost falls without hurting quality.
examples.zh: 「标准单位成本」下降而质量不受损时，采购部便会庆祝。

examples.en: The controller rebased the standard unit cost after the machine upgrade.
examples.zh: 机器升级后，主计长重新核定了「标准单位成本」。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of standard held for sale or use

examples.en: The depot keeps a standard stock of forty days' cover on every fast mover.
examples.zh: 仓库对每个畅销品都保持四十天的「标准库存量」。

examples.en: Falling below standard stock triggers an automatic replenishment order at the DC.
examples.zh: 一旦跌破「标准库存量」，配送中心就会触发自动补货单。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from statement of operating

examples.en: The filing includes a statement of operating revenue broken down by region.
examples.zh: 申报材料中包含按地区细分的「营业收入明细表」。

examples.en: Analysts compared the statement of operating revenue with the segment notes.
examples.zh: 分析师将「营业收入明细表」与分部附注进行了比对。

collocations: settle the statement of operating revenue
estimate the statement of operating revenue
approve the statement of operating revenue

words.enDefinition: a shareholder in the state context

examples.en: As state shareholder, the ministry votes against any share buyback this year.
examples.zh: 作为「国有股股东」，该部今年对所有股份回购都投了反对票。

examples.en: The IPO diluted the state shareholder below the blocking threshold.
examples.zh: 这次 IPO 使「国有股股东」的持股降到了否决门槛以下。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for state

examples.en: The parliament passed the state budget after a late-night vote in December.
examples.zh: 议会于十二月深夜表决通过了「国家预算」。

examples.en: Rail upgrades survived the cuts thanks to a ring-fenced line in the state budget.
examples.zh: 多亏「国家预算」中单列的款项，铁路升级项目躲过了削减。

words.enDefinition: a state a price used in professional practice

examples.en: The dealer refused to state a price until he had inspected the engine.
examples.zh: 在检查发动机之前，经销商拒绝「开价」。

examples.en: Sellers who state a price upfront close deals twice as fast, our data shows.
examples.zh: 我们的数据显示，敢于「先报价」的卖家成交速度快一倍。

words.enDefinition: the cost of starting-load

examples.en: The pitch deck itemizes every starting-load cost, from kiln rental to first wages.
examples.zh: 商业计划书逐项列出了从窑炉租金到首批工资的「筹备成本」。

examples.en: Grants covered half the starting-load cost for the rural packaging workshop.
examples.zh: 补助金支付了这家乡村包装作坊一半的「开办筹备成本」。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for start up

examples.en: Start up costs ate the first year's grants, so the bakery opened on savings.
examples.zh: 「开办费用」用光了第一年的补助，面包房是靠积蓄开起来的。

examples.en: Accountants treat website build-out as start up costs, not as monthly overhead.
examples.zh: 会计把网站建设列为「开办费用」，而不是按月的间接费用。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning staple

examples.en: Cocoa remains the port's staple trade, filling hulls from October onward.
examples.zh: 可可仍是这个港口的「主要贸易」货种，从十月起陆续装船。

examples.en: The museum shows how the staple trade once shaped every warehouse lease.
examples.zh: 博物馆展示了当年的「大宗贸易」如何左右每一份仓库租约。

words.enDefinition: a high-quality trade bill considered low credit risk

examples.en: Discount houses accept a fine trade bill almost at face value.
examples.zh: 贴现行对「优质贸易汇票」几乎按票面价值收贴。

examples.en: Lenders class the paper as a fine trade bill since both firms carry strong ratings.
examples.zh: 由于两家公司信用评级良好，放款人把这张票据列为「可靠贸易汇票」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of finished

examples.en: The finished cost of the cabinet climbed after we switched to brass hinges.
examples.zh: 改用黄铜铰链后，这口橱柜的「完工成本」上涨了。

examples.en: Job cards close only when the supervisor confirms each finished cost total.
examples.zh: 只有主管确认每项「完工成本」后，工单才能关闭。

words.enDefinition: prices charged in firm transactions

examples.en: The catalogue quotes firm prices valid through the whole season.
examples.zh: 价目表所列「稳定价格」在整个销售季内有效。

examples.en: Buyers pressed for firm prices before committing to the annual volume.
examples.zh: 买方要求先敲定「固定价格」，然后才承诺年度采购量。

words.enDefinition: an order related to firm

examples.en: The buyer converted the trial into a firm order within a week.
examples.zh: 买方在一周内把试单转成了「确认订单」。

examples.en: Nothing ships until purchasing raises a firm order signed by both sides.
examples.zh: 在采购部开出双方签署的「确定订单」之前，任何货物都不发货。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for standard labor

examples.en: The shop floor tracks actual hours against standard labor costs on every job.
examples.zh: 车间按每个工单把实际工时与「标准人工成本」进行对照。

examples.en: Union renegotiations forced the plant to recompute its standard labor costs.
examples.zh: 工会重新谈判后，工厂不得不重算「标准人工成本」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of at

examples.en: The founder sells parts to the service team at cost, never at markup.
examples.zh: 创始人向维修团队「按成本价」供应零件，从不加价。
